children: Evolution will continue its previously announced €2.0B share buyback program, with €675.3M remaining. Through Nov. 6, it had repurchased 19,412,197 shares for €1,324.7M; no prior-period comparison was provided.
The board authorized continued repurchases, extending the company’s return-of-capital activity.
Cumulative purchases show most of the €2.0B program has been deployed; figures are as of Nov. 6, 2026.
Up to 15,062,107 more shares may be repurchased
This is the stated share limit under the program’s continuation, subject to the 10% ownership threshold.

This continues a buyback announced in May 2026, with most of its €2.0B allocation already deployed. Further execution and completed-acquisition reports would show how quickly the remaining €675.3M is spent.
